public_ports.begin_ready: output1, high only when no task is active; handshake starts exactly one cold full256-channel task
public_ports.x_ready: output1, accepts X only in initial load phase
public_ports.x_data: input32, exactly1600 accepted words per BEGIN
public_ports.w_ready: output1, accepts512 words for the currently requested pair_group; baseline low during compute/store
public_ports.meta_ready: output1, accepts24 metadata words after the current512 W words; first16 bias, then8 shift
public_ports.pair_group: output3, current requested/processing32-channel group0..7; advances on the same registered edge that asserts pair_done, while pair_done_index reports the old group
public_ports.pair_slot_base: output2, {pair_group[0],1'b0}; two slots are base and base+1
public_ports.x_done: output1 pulse after all X words and all99 hardware row-factor cache writes complete
public_ports.pair_loaded: output1 pulse after W/metadata and32 hardware C/bias/shift cache entries commit
public_ports.pair_done: output1 pulse only after the second tile of a group finishes its final output ACK
public_ports.pair_done_index: output3 captures the completed group, independent of pair_group advancing
public_ports.out_data: output32, four adjacent signed8 channels from one row
public_ports.done: output1 pulse after tile15 word395 ACK, or finite metadata-error completion; this is the uncompressed core-to-encoder handoff, not the final compressed shared-memory write ACK
public_ports.error: output1 sticky for current task; invalid shift metadata is consumed through the end of its24-word block before error completion

stream_rules: Every producer holds valid and payload until ready; each of X/W/meta is an independent32bit ready/valid stream
Consumers may pre-offer the next group while ready is low; payload stays stable until accepted. No slot/control sideband may be guessed from a changing ready signal.
BEGIN has no data payload and cannot overlap an active task. X is loaded exactly once for each BEGIN and reused across all16 tiles within that task only.
For each pair_group, W is followed by its metadata, then two complete output tiles; the first correct implementation does not accept the next pair while DOT/STORE uses W banks.
Output tile/index/data remain stable while valid&&!ready. There is no SRAM/source-to-live engineering copy inside the core.
Reset discards private work. Upstream shared-bus responses and offered transport commands must be drained by the enclosing bridge; this component does not own that bus.
A missing input or indefinitely blocked output waits until progress or reset; this compute component has no separate watchdog. The enclosing bounded control flow must enforce its timeout policy.

input_mapping.X: i0..1599: rp=i>>5,kp=i&31; bytes are X[2rp,2kp],X[2rp,2kp+1],X[2rp+1,2kp],X[2rp+1,2kp+1]. Row99 high half is local zero padding and ignored.
input_mapping.W_pair: i0..511: kp=i>>4,lp=i&15; global columns j=32*pair_group+2lp and j+1. Bytes low-to-high are W[2kp,j],W[2kp+1,j],W[2kp,j+1],W[2kp+1,j+1]. lp<8 targets base slot, lp>=8 targets base+1, lane banks2*(lp&7) and+1.
input_mapping.bias: meta i0..15 packs signed16 biases for pair-local channels2i and2i+1, low channel low half
input_mapping.shift: meta i16..23 packs four unsigned8 shifts for pair-local channels4*(i-16)..+3, low channel low byte
input_mapping.source_padding_note: The16 extra X padding words versus tight row-major packing can be generated by the decoder/reorder adapter; they are not automatically extra shared-SRAM source payload.

output_mapping: tile-major: tile0..15, then row0..98, then four packed words of four adjacent channels;6336 words/25344 output elements per complete task

physical_storage.X: 8x1024x16; bank=row%8, address=(row/8)*32+kp; contents reused across tiles only while current BEGIN epoch is valid
physical_storage.W: 16x128x16; bank=channel%16, address=slot*32+kp; four slots fit in existing macro depth
physical_storage.R99: 2x128x16 in parallel as32bit words; address=row0..98, signed21 row factor sign-extended to32
physical_storage.C_bias_shift: 3x128x16 in parallel as48bit entries; address=slot*16+lane; bits20:0 signedC21,36:21 signedbias16,44:37 shift8,47:45 zero
physical_storage.single_port_rule: No macro can read and write on the same edge; unused addresses do not create a second port. Baseline phases are mutually exclusive; future overlap requires explicit ready/valid arbitration.
physical_storage.slot_epoch: Each slot records valid and its logical tile ID. Loading invalidates the target pair; compute requires matching tile ID, not only a stale valid bit. All slot/R/X validity is cleared per BEGIN.

hardware_factors.products: Two shared signed8x8 product datapaths for the two adjacent-K pairs in each accepted32bit X/W load word; captured products/tags precede signed21 accumulation
hardware_factors.R: Two current-row accumulators, first/last Kpair tags, two-entry completed-row write queue into R99 cache; exactly99 cache writes. Padding row99 never generates a factor.
hardware_factors.C: 32 signed21 accumulators for the current32-channel pair; each channel receives exactly32 products. Final factors are written with bias/shift into the48bit slot metadata cache.

next_bounded_overlap_revision.factor_epoch: At least another R8x21=168 bits plus output context/control to retain the previous output group factors while current R cache reads proceed
next_bounded_overlap_revision.schedule: R cache can fetch the current group during32 paired reads because it is physically separate. A raw snapshot lets four-lane correction/32-cycle store run while the next group computes in roughly35cycles.
